name: Ichibanboshi Maako
source:
She's very innocent.

She is the younger sister of the main character. She lives in Hokkaido and doesn't have a chance to meet in real life.

She's the mood-maker and a mascot to the party.

She is a beginner at online games and is always the first to be killed in boss battles.

Nickname Online: MA-chan.

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/online/character/other.htm#maako]official site[/url]]
